title: Igunya Elingaguquki
intro: Kuwo wonke amazwe asendulo, igunya elinamandla lake laba namandla, lilawula izinsiza eziningi kanye nokuphila kwabantu abaningi. Naphezu kwezibonakaliso nezixwayiso ezicacile, lo mbusi wakhetha indlela yokungalaleli, okwaholela ekubhekaneni okujulile okwakuzozwakala ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.
clues: Ngathi nginamandla amakhulu negunya phezu kombuso omkhulu.
Ngiphonsele inselelo isithunywa esithobekile esithunywe yiNkosi yazo zonke izindawo.
Abantu bakithi babaziwa ngobuchule babo bezakhiwo ezinkulu kanye nomfula owawusekela impucuko yethu.
Ngibone izibonakaliso eziningi ezimangalisayo, okuhlanganisa induku ephenduka inyoka kanye nesandla esikhanyayo.
Ngenqaba ukuvumela iqembu labantu abayizigqila lishiye izwe lami, naphezu kwemiyalo kaNkulunkulu.
Ukuphishekela kwami ​​abantu ababehamba kwangiholela mina namabutho ami enkabeni yolwandle oluhlukene phakathi.
arabic: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا غَـٰفِلِينَ
verse: So We took retribution from them, and We drowned them in the sea because they denied Our signs and were heedless of them. (7:136)
